subject: Locking payment route & VAT customs docs for import duty reimbursement
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliumimports.es>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice INV-2026-0913 — payment route options and customs VAT docs

Hi Marta,

Quick note on invoice INV-2026-0913 (EUR 48,760) — due 2026-05-25. We can accept SEPA credit transfer, international wire, or virtual card. If you prefer a card charge, we usually put a 3–5 business day processing buffer.

Because you mentioned this is an import where customs may be reclaiming VAT/duty, Finance asked that we get the following before payment clears:
- Import customs declaration (CN23/IE or equivalent) showing duty paid
- VAT reclaim certificate or local VAT registration confirmation

If you can share a scanned customs receipt + VAT proof, we’ll mark the invoice as eligible for the import duty reimbursement process on our side (helps accelerate the refund to your AP team).

Please tell me which payment method you prefer and whether AP can provide the customs paperwork by EOD Tue (2026-05-18). If card is easiest, we can provision a virtual card and prioritize posting.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: INV-2026-0913.pdf (invoice PDF)

From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliumimports.es>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-16T11:04:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-0913 — payment route options and customs VAT docs

Hi Sergio,

Thanks — we received the invoice. AP prefers SEPA if possible. Two constraints:
1) Our bank requires a customs receipt to mark this as reclaimable VAT; without it finance will hold payment until next monthly run (30+ days).
2) Virtual card is possible but we need card detail cut-off approval from treasury first; that can add 48 hours.

I can share a scanned customs import receipt and our VAT filing extract. I expect to upload both by Tue 2026-05-18. Can you confirm SEPA details (IBAN + beneficiary entity) and whether you need any additional remittance reference fields?

Best,
Marta
AP Manager — Helium Imports S.A.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-16T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice INV-2026-0913 — note on customs docs

Sergio / Lauren —

Forwarding Marta's note. Finance (me) — confirmed SEPA OK. Beneficiary: Redwood Inference EU GmbH
IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00
BIC: COBADEFFXXX
Please ask AP to include remittance: INV-2026-0913 and HeliumImports VAT ID: ESB12345678.

If they upload the customs receipt and VAT extract by Tue we can release on the 18th in that weekly batch. If they ask for virtual card, we can provision one — but that requires Trevor in treasury to sign off for cards over EUR 25k.

Let me know if you want me to pre-approve the TREASURY sign-off to speed card option.

-Ben
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: VAT_certificate_request_template.docx (docx)

From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliumimports.es>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ap@heliumimports.es
Date: 2026-05-18T08:47:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-0913 — customs docs uploaded

Hi Ben / Sergio,

We uploaded the customs import receipt and VAT filing extract to the SharePoint link you provided. Files: customs_receipt_120526.pdf, VAT_extract_Q1_2026.pdf.

We will initiate a SEPA transfer today for the principal amount, but please confirm whether Redwood will withhold a short escrow pending duty reimbursement processing or whether you can net the duty amount once refund clears. AP prefers not to hold funds longer than needed.

If Redwood requires an escrow window, we need dates and the amount to expect. Otherwise we will push the SEPA now.

Regards,
Marta

Related link: https://heliumimports.sharepoint.com/sites/AP/Attachments/INV-2026-0913

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliumimports.es>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-0913 — customs docs uploaded

Marta —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for uploading the docs. Good news — Finance will accept the SEPA and will not hold funds in escrow as long as the uploaded customs receipt matches the payment reference. We will post the invoice as "pending duty reimbursement" and initiate the reimbursement workflow once the refund is issued by customs. Typical timeline: 7–21 business days depending on local authorities.

Action items / next steps:
- Helium AP: proceed with SEPA today, include remittance INV-2026-0913 and VAT ID ESB12345678.
- Redwood Finance (Ben): monitor incoming payment and link the uploaded customs receipt to the payment record.
- Sergio: I'll follow up if treasury needs to provision a virtual card fallback and will notify Marta if any issues.

If AP hits a processing block (bank rejects missing field), reply-all and Ben will provide a specific structured remittance file for bank import.

Thanks — will confirm once payment posts.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: INV-2026-0913.pdf, VAT_certificate_request_template.docx
